note: Racial changes the server has and the client tables don't, carried into ui/core/forever/racials.json by tools/sources/racials.py after it reads the client. Each entry names a race and a client spell id. 'description' and 'cost' replace that racial's text and cost line; 'replace' swaps the racial for a new one in its place; 'remove' drops it. Every variant it touches gets source 'hotfix' and the note. Drop an entry once a client build carries it (racials.py says when the client text already matches).

entries.description: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. Can only occur once every 15 sec.
entries.note: development notes 2026-10-27 (post 8): internal cooldown 15 sec (was 25 sec); client 70634 reads ProcCategoryRecovery 25000

entries.description: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line, it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
entries.note: development notes 2026-10-26 (post 7): 50% (was 100%) for 15 sec, Attuned 100% for 1 hour at a Ley Line; client 70630 reads 100% for 30 sec or 15 min

entries.description: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence, it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%.
entries.note: development notes 2026-10-26 (post 7): 15% (was 10%) for 15 sec, Charged 30% for 1 hour at a convergence; client 70630 reads 10% for 30 sec or 15 min
